summary.result: The Kolmogorov- Smirnov(K-S) test results of IWRR and PWAR showed the characteristics classification by rice growing stage and stable normal distribution characteristics.
summary.background: The purpose of study was analyze the pumping characteristics, Irrigation Efficiency(IE), and irrigation pattern by period of rice growing stage with based on the performance of design irrigation water requirement and operational Galshin Pumping(GP) station in GP irrigation district constructed under rural water development project master plan.
summary.method: The IWR were calculated using the Blaney-Criddle formula of the HOMWRS program, Hydrological Operation Model for Water Resource System, developed by Korea Rural Community Corporation.

summary_ko.background: 본 연구의 목적은 농촌수자원개발사업 주요계획에 따라 설계된 갈신양수장(GP) 관개지구의 운영 현황을 바탕으로 벼 재배단계별로 관개용수량(IWR)의 성능, 관개효율(IE), 그리고 관개패턴을 분석하는 것이었다.

summary_ko.result: IWRR 및 PWAR에 대한 콜모고로프-스미르노프(K-S) 검정 결과는 벼 재배단계별 분류 특성과 안정적인 정규분포 특성을 보여주었다.
